verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client. Its SSH support covers Git transport and SSH keys, plus SSH commands for listing repositories on self-hosted servers. It is not a terminal or SSH session client, so grouping terminal sessions and broadcasting commands to them falls outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships interactive terminal sessions.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can group multiple terminal sessions together and broadcast the same command to all of them
